title: COSI — Maintenance Document Payload
description: Payload for maintenance-document messages (assetClass=maintenance-document). Carries manual PDF links and recurring service task definitions for one machine component.

DocumentRef.description: Pointer to a document in an external system or file store.

uniqueRef.description: Stable unique identifier for this document across systems.

documentLink.description: URI or file-system path to a locally accessible document. The reference does not authorize bypassing the IT/OT boundary.

componentId.description: Unique identifier of the machine component this document record belongs to.

validFrom.description: ISO 8601 UTC date from which this document version is valid.

manualDocs.description: Maintenance manual documents for this component, ordered by document type or relevance.

taskId.description: Unique identifier for this service task.

value.description: Numeric interval after which the task must be performed.

uom.description: Counter unit: h = machine runtime hours; m² = board area produced; pcs = pieces produced; cycles = machine cycles.

counterSource.description: Name of the machine counter used to track frequency.

serviceTasks.description: Recurring service tasks for this component, each with a frequency trigger and reference to the task instruction document.
